inlines.text: Muse Spark Open 在 vLLM 上的 Day 0 支持

blocks.text: 我们很高兴与 Meta Superintelligence Labs 合作，在 Day 0 就将 Muse Spark Open 引入 vLLM。Muse Spark Open 是一个开放权重的稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型，专为长时程智能体编程工作流打造。它是迄今为止能力最强的美国开放权重模型，也是 Muse Glimmer 30B 蒸馏自的模型。

inlines.text: 我们很高兴与 Meta Superintelligence Labs 合作，在 Day 0 就将 Muse Spark Open 引入 vLLM。Muse Spark Open 是一个开放权重的稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型，专为长时程智能体编程工作流打造。它是迄今为止能力最强的美国开放权重模型，也是 Muse Glimmer 30B 蒸馏自的模型。
架构：总参数 816B，每 token 激活 42B，上下文窗口 1M。
量化：Meta 以 BF16 和 NVFP4 两种格式发布了该模型。MXFP4 权重由 AMD 发布。
多模态：通过与其 Muse Glimmer 相同的 Perception Encoder 实现原生图像和视频感知，并额外支持音频。
并行：在 Nvidia 和 AMD 上均支持张量并行和流水线并行。在 Nvidia 上支持 EP、TEP、DEP 和 PD 分离。还提供对 TPU 的初步支持。
投机解码：我们训练了一个 DSpark 草稿模型，在 CUDA 和 ROCm 上均受支持，可加速模型性能，已在 SPEED bench 上测试。

blocks.text: 潜在 MoE 池化器和反池化器

inlines.text: 潜在 MoE 池化器和反池化器

blocks.text: 潜在 MoE。每个专家混合（MoE）层都带有两个额外的矩阵，由该层中所有 256 个专家共享。代码称它们为池化器和反池化器，不过两者都不是通常意义上的池化，而是用于压缩和扩展维度的学习投影。池化器是一个 8192 × 4096 的矩阵，在 token 到达专家之前将其宽度减半；而反池化器之后会恢复完整宽度。因此专家完全在 4096 而非 8192 上工作，这实际上将两个专家投影层所需的参数量减半。

blocks.text: 混合滑动窗口和全注意力

inlines.text: 混合滑动窗口和全注意力

blocks.text: 混合注意力。 各层在完整注意力和滑动窗口注意力（SWA）之间交替，以 4 层为一个重复周期，其中三层关注 2048 token 的窗口，第四层关注整个上下文。该周期锚定在堆栈末尾，因此最后一层始终是完整注意力层。在 62 层中，这给出 46 个窄层和 16 个宽层，其中窄层只保留最近的 KV。在 1M token 时，这使缓存仅为全完整注意力所需缓存略多于 ¼ 的量。这正是 1M 上下文长度变得可负担的原因。

blocks.text: 视觉编码器。 Muse Spark Open 使用与 Muse Glimmer 相同的 Perception Encoder，这是一个 2B 参数的塔，按图像原生分辨率读取图像，而不是将其调整为正方形。视频通过同一编码器处理：帧在加载时被采样为一系列采样视频帧，并在提示中对时间戳进行 token 化。

blocks.text: 音频编码器。 音频以 24 kHz 的原始波形读取，每 1920 个采样，即 80ms，通过一系列变换成为一个 token。整个音频编码器只有 118M 参数。请注意，视频的音轨不会被处理。要让模型同时获得一个片段的画面和声音，请将视频和提取出的音频作为同一请求中的两个独立内容部分发送。

blocks.text: 我们在 TorchTPU 之上添加了对 TPU 上 Muse Spark Open 的支持。请联系我们或 Google 获取代码访问权限。我们还为 Muse Spark Open 构建了 megakernels。使用 DSpark 推测解码（接受长度 = 6），它们在 4 个 TPU v7 芯片上达到超过 650 tokens/sec，在 8 个芯片上达到超过 960 tokens/sec。不使用推测解码时，它们仍分别提供超过 270 和 350 tokens/sec。

blocks.text: vLLM 还从第 0 天起就支持在 Muse Spark Open 上进行 LoRA RL，作为 rollout 引擎，并以 Verl FSDP2 作为训练器。vLLM 提供原始 NVFP4 checkpoint，并在其上应用 LoRA adapter。训练器在相同权重的 BF16 反量化版本上运行，并且只更新 adapter（rank 32，alpha 64），其覆盖 attention、MoE latent projections 以及所有 routed experts。它还会重放 rollout 的 MoE routing（R3），并且每一步之后只有 adapter 会被同步回 vLLM。

blocks.text: 我们在 16 张 GB300 GPU 上使用 GRPO 在 DAPO-Math-17K 上训练了 150 步，每步对 32 个 prompt 各采样 8 个响应，每个响应最多 4K tokens。AIME-2024 上的准确率（mean@8）从训练前的 0.56 提升到运行结束时的 0.85。在整个运行过程中，训练器与 vLLM 的 log-probabilities 之间的 k3 KL 保持在接近 2×10⁻⁴。更多细节见 https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8257。在 vLLM 生态中，Titan RL 也使用 vLLM 作为其 rollout 引擎，以提供第 0 天 RL 支持。

blocks.text: We're excited to have worked with Meta Superintelligence Labs to bring Muse Spark Open to vLLM on day 0. Muse Spark Open is an open-weight sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, built for long-horizon agentic coding workflows. It is the most capable US open-weights model to date and it is the model Muse Glimmer 30B was distilled from.

inlines.text: We're excited to have worked with Meta Superintelligence Labs to bring Muse Spark Open to vLLM on day 0. Muse Spark Open is an open-weight sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, built for long-horizon agentic coding workflows. It is the most capable US open-weights model to date and it is the model Muse Glimmer 30B was distilled from.
Architecture: 816B total parameters, 42B active per token with a 1M context window.
Quantization: Meta released the model in both BF16 and NVFP4. MXFP4 weights were released by AMD.
Multimodal: Native image and video perception through the same Perception Encoder as Muse Glimmer, with additional audio support.
Parallelism: Tensor Parallelism and Pipeline Parallelism on both Nvidia and AMD. EP, TEP, DEP and PD disaggregation on Nvidia. Initial support on TPU is also available.
Speculative decoding: We have trained a DSpark draft model, supported on both CUDA and ROCm that accelerates the model performance, tested on the SPEED bench.

blocks.text: Sandwich normalization. Most decoders put one normalization layer before each block, giving x + F(norm(x)) Muse Spark Open, similar to Muse Glimmer, place one before and one after, like the two slices of a sandwich with the block sitting in between, giving x + post_norm(F(norm(x)))

blocks.text: Latent MoE. Every mixture-of-experts (MoE) layer carries two extra matrices, shared by all 256 experts in that layer. The code calls them the pooler and unpooler, though neither is pooling in the usual sense, instead both are learned projections to squeeze and expand the dimensions. The pooler is an 8192 × 4096 matrix that halves each token's width before it reaches the experts; while the unpooler restores the full width afterwards. The experts therefore work entirely at 4096 rather than 8192, which effectively halved the number of parameters required in the two expert projection layers.

inlines.text: . Every mixture-of-experts (MoE) layer carries two extra matrices, shared by all 256 experts in that layer. The code calls them the pooler and unpooler, though neither is pooling in the usual sense, instead both are learned projections to squeeze and expand the dimensions. The pooler is an 8192 × 4096 matrix that halves each token's width before it reaches the experts; while the unpooler restores the full width afterwards. The experts therefore work entirely at 4096 rather than 8192, which effectively halved the number of parameters required in the two expert projection layers.

blocks.text: Hybrid attention. Layers alternate between full attention and Sliding Window Attention (SWA) on a repeating cycle of 4 with three attending to a 2048-token window and the fourth looking at the whole context. The cycle is anchored to the end of the stack so the final layer is always a full attention layer. Across 62 layers, that gives 46 narrow layers and 16 wide ones where the narrow layers only hold recent KV. At 1M tokens, this brings the cache to just over ¼ of what all-full attention would need. This is what makes 1M context length affordable.

blocks.text: Vision Encoder. Muse Spark Open uses the same Perception Encoder as Muse Glimmer, a 2B parameter tower that reads images at their native resolution, rather than resizing them to a square. Videos run through the same encoder: frames are sampled at load time as a series of sampled video frames with timestamp tokenized in the prompt.

inlines.text: Muse Spark Open uses the same Perception Encoder as Muse Glimmer, a 2B parameter tower that reads images at their native resolution, rather than resizing them to a square. Videos run through the same encoder: frames are sampled at load time as a series of sampled video frames with timestamp tokenized in the prompt.

blocks.text: Audio Encoder. Audio is read as raw waveform at 24 kHz and Every 1920 samples, i.e. 80ms become one token through a series of transformations. The whole audio encoder is just 118M parameters. Note that the video's audio track is not processed. To give the model both the pictures and the sound of a clip, send the video and the extracted audio as two separate content parts in the same request.

blocks.text: To accelerate Muse Spark Open inference on vLLM, we trained a speculator using DSpark, a speculative decoding algorithm that uses block diffusion to propose up to seven draft tokens in a single pass. Confidence-based scheduling helps sustain significant speedups even at large batch sizes, where speculative decoding traditionally offers diminishing returns, as shown in the results below.

inlines.text: To accelerate Muse Spark Open inference on vLLM, we trained a speculator using DSpark, a speculative decoding algorithm that uses block diffusion to propose up to seven draft tokens in a single pass. Confidence-based scheduling helps sustain significant speedups even at large batch sizes, where speculative decoding traditionally offers diminishing returns, as shown in the results below.

blocks.text: Our speculator also uses the Muse Spark Open sliding-window attention to keep drafting lightweight, even with a 1M-token context. Together, these choices make it well suited to production workloads spanning a wide range of batch sizes and context lengths.

blocks.text: Nvidia team improved Muse Spark Open inference across FlashInfer and vLLM through fused normalization, gating, and residual kernels; fused MoE finalization with tensor-parallel communication and RMSNorm; a new low-latency BF16 GEMM implementation and reduced compilation overhead; TEP pooler/unpooler sharding with fused MNNVL collectives; TF32 router GEMM fed by the norm's FP32 output; and improvements to data movement, hardware support, and runtime reliability.

blocks.text: Thanks to the AMD team, we have also supported the model on AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs, in both FP8 and MXFP4 quantized formats, providing improved inference performance and deployment efficiency. Note that ROCm currently supports both Tensor-Parallel and Pipeline-Parallelism.

blocks.text: We have added support for Muse Spark Open on TPU on top of TorchTPU. Please contact us or Google for code access. We have also built megakernels for Muse Spark Open. With DSpark speculative decoding (acceptance length = 6), they reach over 650 tokens/sec on 4 TPU v7 chips and over 960 tokens/sec on 8 chips. Without speculative decoding, they still deliver over 270 and 350 tokens/sec, respectively.

blocks.text: vLLM also supports LoRA RL on Muse Spark Open from day 0, serving as the rollout engine with Verl FSDP2 as the trainer. vLLM serves the original NVFP4 checkpoint with the LoRA adapter applied on top. The trainer runs on a BF16 dequantization of the same weights and updates only the adapter (rank 32, alpha 64), which covers attention, the MoE latent projections and all routed experts. It also replays the rollout’s MoE routing (R3), and only the adapter is synced back to vLLM after each step.

blocks.text: We trained with GRPO on DAPO-Math-17K for 150 steps on 16 GB300 GPUs, sampling 8 responses for each of 32 prompts per step with up to 4K tokens per response. The accuracy on AIME-2024 (mean@8) went from 0.56 before training to 0.85 by the end of the run. Throughout the run, the k3 KL between the trainer’s and vLLM’s log-probabilities held near 2×10⁻⁴. More details are available in https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8257. In the vLLM ecosystem, Titan RL also uses vLLM as its rollout engine to provide day-0 RL support.
